Ignored levels are always respected sooner or later. Reason = Demand becomes Supply and vice versa. Also they are fresh levels once they break something significant. In this case I think it broke flag limit.

Madmoney, you might already realize this and if so please disregard my comment...

For me, I find the FL or area I'm going to trade before I start looking for a LS. For the chart you provided, I agree with Dengaima completely. The strong break and ignored demand get my attention. Then I'm examining the FL / Ign D area under LTF to find the boundaries. And then finally I'm looking further left to find the LS that matches with my DP to identify my entry.

If I marked every significant higher or low on my chart, the chart would soon be unreadable. So it seems more logical to find these last to me.
